text:
Sam (DevRel): new proposal: "BridgeKit Labs" 1 short tutorials + 1 tiny reference app + compact benchmark note + 30-min live demo. tight funnel to drive dev signups and measurable repo signals. volunteers?
Ivy (Growth): yes — want clear funnel metrics: RSVP -> attend -> fork -> trial start. also need UTMs and a lead-routing plan.
Noel (Content): I'll draft the launch post, two tutorial posts (GIF steps), and a short follow-up email with bench highlights. need the hero stat from Tess.
Tess (PMM): bench story: show Optimize preset vs baseline + quantized run. hero stat candidate: "~37% lower per-token cost using prefix caching + quant int8". I'll run reproducible bench and add logs to the repo.
Rory (Design): I'll make a hero image, social cards, and 3 step GIF templates. need final art 48h before publish.
webhook-bot: uploaded assets: drive.redwood.ai/bridgekit/assets (starter-repo, slides, asset-pack)
Sam (DevRel): routing idea: tag leads `bridgekit_*`. segments: visited_tutorial, registered, attended, forked_repo. high-engagers -> SE trial queue. add `source=bridgekit` in webhook payloads.
Ivy (Growth): UTMs sample: `?utm_source=bridgekit&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=bridgekit_labs`. segmentation rules sound good. I'll wire hidden field on the form.
Noel (Content): rough social copy: "BridgeKit Labs: 2 short tutorials + a live lab to ship an LLM mini-feature in 30 minutes. RSVP." email subject: "Ship a tiny LLM feature in 30 minutes 1 BridgeKit Labs"
Tess (PMM): draft bench command (to publish in repo): `python tools/bench.py --model rwd-small --seq 384 --batch 12 --quantize int8 --cache prefix` — will include machine spec & raw logs.
Rory (Design): thumbnails: 1200x1200 + 16:9 hero. uploading v1 now. mobile-first GIF variants included.
Sam (DevRel): owners: Noel=copy & tutorials, Tess=bench + numbers, Rory=design, Ivy=distribution + routing, Sam=webinar ops + repo maintainer. agree?
All: :+1:
Noel (Content): timeline proposal:
- Day0: announce blog + tutorial #1 + social drip
- Day2: tutorial #2 + RSVP push
- Day5: 30-min live demo + publish benchmark short post + follow-up email with bench artifacts
Can condense if needed.
Ivy (Growth): condense OK if bench becomes appendix. I'll set up the form, UTMs, and lead webhook rules. I'll also add a Slack alert for high-engagers.
Sam (DevRel): CTA copy for registration: "Join BridgeKit Labs: a 30-min hands-on lab to build, benchmark, and ship a tiny LLM feature." short form fields: name, company, email, role, interest area.
webhook-bot: created PR: github.com/redwood-inference/bridgekit/pull/21 (initial tutorial + assets)
Tess (PMM): hero stat provisional until bench runs finish. aiming to push logs by EOD. will prepare 2-slide "how we measured" for the live demo.
Rory (Design): note: please confirm brand color choice A or B by EOD so I can finalize thumbnails. uploaded two options to drive.
Noel (Content): posting checklist: repo link, quickstart README, 2 GIFs per tutorial, bench logs, email copy, CTAs (star repo, try a free trial). PR will have a checklist in description.
Ivy (Growth): routing rules: attendees -> tag:bridgekit_attended; forks -> tag:bridgekit_forked; attend+fork -> tag:bridgekit_hot. send webhook with `source=bridgekit`. SEops to get bridgekit_hot alerts.
Sam (DevRel): small ops ask: include the tag in the webhook and surface UTMs in the lead payload. ops, please add a 24h pre-publish reminder.
webhook-bot: scheduled reminder: 24h before publish to #marketing and opened PR for review.
Noel (Content): I'll wait for Tess to confirm hero stat before scheduling the blog. once green, I'll queue social posts and the email.
Tess (PMM): running bench now. preliminary numbers look promising; will confirm exact hero stat after one more run. logs will be in the PR.
Sam (DevRel): perfect. action items: everyone add ETA in PR and flag blockers by EOD. excited for a compact, dev-focused launch that surfaces strong signal. :rocket:
